from typing import Annotated

def count_english_vowels(text: Annotated[str, "Text to examine; Unicode allowed, up to 16000 characters"]) -> Annotated[int, "Number of unaccented English vowels, ignoring case"]:
    """
    Count occurrences of the five English vowels a, e, i, o and u in text.
    Ignore letter case and count repetitions. Accented characters are allowed
    as text but are not normalized into English vowels: they contribute zero themselves;
    other unaccented vowels in the same text still count.
    
    Args:
        text: Text to examine; Unicode allowed, up to 16000 characters
        
    Returns:
        Number of unaccented English vowels, ignoring case
        
    Raises:
        TypeError: If input is not a string
        ValueError: If input string exceeds 16000 characters
    """
    # Input validation
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        raise TypeError("Input must be a string")
    
    if len(text) > 16000:
        raise ValueError("Input string must not exceed 16000 characters")
    
    # Define English vowels
    vowels = set('aeiouAEIOU')
    
    # Count vowels in text
    count = 0
    for char in text:
        if char in vowels:
            count += 1
    
    return count
